name: WhatsApp
description: Chat with a Paperclip agent on WhatsApp, from a number linked to this server as a WhatsApp device. Direct messages and mention-only groups.

methods.label: Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Talk to one Paperclip agent from WhatsApp: linked people in direct messages, and enabled groups when the agent is mentioned.
methods.guidanceMd: Pair the WhatsApp number once on the server with `node scripts/bu/whatsapp-pair.mjs` (WhatsApp → Linked devices → Link a device), then enter the folder it wrote. Only linked people get answers; groups must be enabled and answer only when the agent is @mentioned or replied to.
